Hero.title: Build the product that keeps work moving.
Hero.body: Bring the process that needs fixing. We turn it into focused software and keep the project clear from the first brief to the handover.

proof.detail: A clear place to explain the problem before anyone starts building.
Every stage and update is part of the same project record.
The result, source and context remain accessible after delivery.

Capabilities.title: Software with a job to do, not filler.
Capabilities.description: The best projects start with a real bottleneck, a useful question or a task that has outgrown the tools around it.

items.title: Internal tools
items.body: Replace the spreadsheet behind a critical process with software your team can use every day.

items.title: Customer products
items.body: Portals, booking flows and account areas that feel fast and dependable on every screen.

items.title: Integrations
items.body: Connect the systems you already rely on and keep the data moving without manual copy and paste.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Give the team one trustworthy view of the numbers instead of a collection of competing files.

items.title: Recovery work
items.body: Stabilise a stalled codebase, untangle the risky parts and leave it easier to change.

items.title: The next release
items.body: Keep improving a product with the same people, context and project history close at hand.

Process.title: A short path from a note to a useful release.
Process.description: No sales maze. The written brief starts the conversation, and the project space keeps it moving.

steps.title: Write down the work
steps.body: Open an account and add the goal, the people it serves, the parts that matter and anything that should not change.

steps.title: Shape the scope
steps.body: We read the brief, ask useful questions in the project thread and agree what belongs in the first release.

steps.title: Build with the thread open
steps.body: The status, decisions and updates stay together, so the project is easy to follow without chasing messages.

steps.title: Review and hand over
steps.body: You review the result before delivery. The source, instructions and project history stay available in the account.

Faq.title: A few useful answers.
Faq.description: If your question is not here, include it in the brief. It will be answered in the project thread.

entries.question: What happens after I submit a request?
entries.answer: Your brief becomes a project with its own reference and activity record. Someone reads it, replies in the project thread and works with you on the scope.

entries.question: How do you price the work?
entries.answer: After reading the brief. An honest estimate depends on the scope, so the conversation and any changes stay visible in the project thread.

entries.question: Who owns the code?
entries.answer: You do. Delivery includes the source, migrations and deployment notes, so the product is not tied to a black box.

entries.question: Can you take over an existing project?
entries.answer: Yes. Tell us what is working, what is not and what cannot break. We start by making the project safe to build on again.

entries.question: Do you use AI while building?
entries.answer: We use tools where they help, but the engineer responsible for the work reviews every change. The outcome is tested software, not unreviewed output.

entries.question: How do I follow progress?
entries.answer: The project page keeps the status, history and conversation together. You can check it at any time and updates arrive while it is open.

NewOrder.problemPlaceholder: What is broken or missing today, and what should improve?

NewOrder.techHint: Optional. Leave empty if you have no constraints.
